fuels.title: S/C3 / C4. Test freight, rail and power before setting diesel import requirements
fuels.bridge: More road activity and power use raise diesel demand; efficiency, rail and domestic output reduce the import requirement.

fuels.title: S/C3 / C4. Build jet demand from aircraft movements and fuel burn before estimating imports
fuels.bridge: Traffic and fuel burn set total jet demand; SAF changes the fossil share, while refinery output sets the import balance.

levers.label:
Aircraft movements
2024 = 100
levers.rationale: Authored flat / recovery / expansion tests. Follow Manish's movement driver; re-fit against matched jet deliveries.
levers.anchor: Registered ACSA movement source; target indices authored

levers.label:
Fuel burn per movement
2024 = 100
levers.rationale: Lower burn lowers litres. Separate aircraft efficiency from route length, aircraft size and international mix.
levers.anchor: Authored intensity tests; ICAO supports mechanism, not these SA values

levers.label:
SAF share of jet deliveries
% by volume
levers.reference:
SA blend baseline unknown
Not a local mandate
levers.rationale: Changes fossil jet share, not total jet litres. Authored blend tests; ICAO's 5% emissions vision is not a volume target.
levers.anchor: Authored SA sensitivity; ICAO global framework only

fuels.title: S/C3 / C4. Test travel, fleet growth and electrification before setting petrol import requirements
fuels.bridge: Travel and fleet additions raise petrol demand; electrification and new-cohort efficiency offset growth before supply is matched.

levers.label:
Passenger mileage
km / vehicle / year
levers.rationale: Authored ±20% around the current mileage placeholder. Higher mileage raises petrol demand at a given fleet.
levers.anchor: Registered provisional passenger mileage

levers.label:
Real GDP growth
% per year
levers.rationale: Bracket the 2% continuation proposal. Drives fleet additions through the fitted relationship, not a second fuel multiplier.
